#!/bin/bash
# Twitch & Kick Drops Miner Installation Script
apt update
apt install -y git curl ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "true" ] || [ "${USER_UPLOAD}" == "1" ]; then
    echo -e "User upload enabled, skipping git clone."
else
    if [ -d .git ]; then
        echo -e "Updating existing git repository..."
        git pull
    else
        if [ "$(ls -A /mnt/server)" ]; then
            echo -e "/mnt/server directory is not empty, cloning into temporary directory and copying files..."
            git clone --branch ${BRANCH:-main} ${GIT_ADDRESS} /tmp/repo
            cp -r /tmp/repo/. /mnt/server/
            rm -rf /tmp/repo
        else
            echo -e "Cloning ${GIT_ADDRESS} (branch: ${BRANCH:-main})..."
            git clone --branch ${BRANCH:-main} ${GIT_ADDRESS} .
        fi
    fi
fi

mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

echo -e "Installing Python requirements..."
if [ -f /mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE:-requirements.txt} ]; then
    HOME=/mnt/server pip install -U --prefix /mnt/server/.local -r /mnt/server/${REQUIREMENTS_FILE:-requirements.txt}
fi

echo -e "-----------------------------------------"
echo -e "Installation completed successfully!"
echo -e "Allocate port 8920 in Pterodactyl to access the Web UI."
echo -e "-----------------------------------------"
